      Problem: Bash local variable scoping bug — the local variable is not visible to the called function `run_preflight_checks`. The conditional at line 11,174 evaluates to `true` (because "false" != "true"), causing `: > "${PRE_FLIGHT_LOG_FILE}"` to execute and wipe the log. This defeats the purpose of preserving initial failure diagnostics for post-rerun comparison.
